newsitem.title: USA: RGI group sells stake in Koger for $36.8 mln.
newsitem.headline: RGI group sells stake in Koger for $36.8 mln.

text.p: A group including Resource Group International Inc and Norwegian investor Kjell Rokke said Tuesday it sold its stake in Koger Equity for $36.8 million.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, thegroup said it sold its stake totalling 2.45 million shares at $15 a share to a group of institutional investors.
The buyers included Alliance Growth Fund, Equitable Retirement Plan, Smith Barney/Travelers Series Fund and Alliance Variable Products Series Fund, according to the filing.
The RGI group said in March it was exploring alternatives, including the sale of its stake in Koger. At the time, it said it held a 13.8 percent stake in Koger.
